verdict.rationale: Together documents serving custom weights it produced: LoRA or full fine-tunes trained on the platform can be deployed to dedicated endpoints, and it handles the full lifecycle from data upload to hosting. There is no evidence of uploading weights or LoRA adapters trained elsewhere, which is the core 'upload my own' part of the story. Missing for 10: documented upload/import of externally trained model weights, upload and serving of external LoRA adapters (including serverless LoRA serving), independent hands-on corroboration.
